title_ja: 調達・共同投資・システム整備計画案
title_en: Procurement, joint investment, and deployment scenarios
summary_ja: 公示、仕様、契約総額、保守、段階導入をシステム整備計画案へ変換する暫定ロードマップです。落札総額から非公開の部品単価を逆算しません。
summary_en: A provisional roadmap translating notices, specifications, total awards, support, and staged deployment into system plans. It does not reverse-engineer undisclosed component prices from total awards.

tracks.name_ja: 公示・仕様・契約範囲
tracks.summary_ja: 金額、対象、期間、保守、仕様の対応を追跡します。
tracks.summary_en: Track amount, scope, term, support, and specification correspondence.
tracks.current_state_ja: 国内公示と欧州の契約資料には総額例がありますが、同じ費目内訳ではありません。
tracks.current_state_en: Japanese notices and European contract records provide total examples but not matched cost breakdowns.
tracks.hpci_implications_ja: 購入と賃貸、保守、電力・施設、税、移行を分けて比較します。
tracks.hpci_implications_en: Separate purchase and lease, support, power/facility, tax, and migration.

tracks.name_ja: 価格帯別・段階導入案
tracks.summary_ja: 複数予算帯で機能と規模の下限・上限を示します。
tracks.summary_en: Show capability and scale bounds across multiple budget bands.
tracks.current_state_ja: 現在の公開データでは5年TCOと部品内訳が揃わず、価格帯案は正式評価できません。
tracks.current_state_en: Current public data lacks complete five-year TCO and itemization, so budget-band options cannot be formally scored.
tracks.hpci_implications_ja: 同じ費用境界と期間で少なくとも5価格帯を比較します。
tracks.hpci_implications_en: Compare at least five budget bands using matched cost boundaries and periods.

milestones.label_ja: 公示・契約総額の対応を確認
milestones.detail_ja: 複数案件の公開総額・対象を確認しましたが、部品別価格や同一の5年費用境界はありません。
milestones.detail_en: Public totals and scopes were checked for multiple cases, but component prices and matched five-year boundaries are unavailable.

milestones.label_ja: 部品別5年TCOの比較時期は未確定
milestones.label_en: Itemized five-year TCO comparison is undated
milestones.detail_ja: 購入、賃貸、保守、電力、冷却、施設、移行、撤去を揃えた公開案件は未確認です。
milestones.detail_en: No public case yet aligns purchase/lease, support, power, cooling, facility, migration, and decommissioning.

milestones.label_ja: 5年費用テンプレートの暫定判断点
milestones.detail_ja: 価格帯を算出する前に費用境界、税、期間、割引、保守範囲を固定する暫定計画です。
milestones.detail_en: A provisional plan to fix cost boundary, tax, term, discounts, and support scope before computing budget bands.

milestones.label_ja: 5価格帯の正式提示は未確定
milestones.detail_ja: 5年TCOと性能・施設制約が揃うまで数値案を推測しません。
milestones.detail_en: Numeric options will not be inferred until five-year TCO, performance, and facility constraints align.

dependencies.statement_ja: 予算境界、契約期間、保守、施設費が実現可能なシステム規模を制約します。
dependencies.statement_en: Budget boundaries, contract terms, support, and facility costs constrain feasible system scale.

Furo NEXT award notice
sources.publisher: JETRO (Tokai National Higher Education and Research System announcement)

coverage_gaps.impact_ja: 価格帯別のシステム規模を比較できません。
coverage_gaps.impact_en: System scale cannot be compared across budget bands.
coverage_gaps.next_action_ja: 購入・賃貸、保守、電力、冷却、施設、移行、撤去、税を案件別に記録します。
coverage_gaps.next_action_en: Record purchase/lease, support, power, cooling, facility, migration, decommissioning, and tax per case.

coverage_gaps.scope_ja: 仕様書と落札額の部品対応
coverage_gaps.impact_ja: 総額から各コンポーネント価格を信頼できる形で分離できません。
coverage_gaps.impact_en: Component prices cannot be reliably separated from total awards.
coverage_gaps.next_action_ja: 公開仕様書、数量、契約範囲、保守年数を対応付け、非公開値は未知のまま残します。
coverage_gaps.next_action_en: Map public specifications, quantities, scope, and support term; leave undisclosed values unknown.

caveat_ja: 単一のAIモデル・単一エージェントによる暫定調査です。独立したAIモデルによるConsensus Gateは未完了です。公表資料の確認時点、公開目標、OpenFSの暫定計画を区別し、未公表の時期・費用・性能は推測していません。
caveat_en: Provisional research by one model and one agent; Consensus review by independent models is incomplete. Documentation checks, published targets, and provisional OpenFS plans are separated, and unpublished timing, cost, and performance are not inferred.
